+def _screen_xml() -> str:
+    """Read the current native UI hierarchy once through uiautomator.
+
+    For values the agent's summary may shorten or misread, such as a long URL.
+    ARTEMIS keeps its own UIAutomator session open for a few seconds after a

+        try:
+            _adb("shell", "uiautomator", "dump", "/sdcard/artemis-screen.xml")
+            break
+        except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
+            if attempt == 9:
+                raise
+            time.sleep(2)
+    return _adb("exec-out", "cat", "/sdcard/artemis-screen.xml").stdout.decode("utf-8")

+def screen_texts() -> list[str]:

+def screen_packages() -> set[str]:

**Check the active window root package, not every node package.** `uiautomator dump` returns the active window hierarchy, but each node carries its own package. If a visible descendant belongs to `PDF_VIEWER_PACKAGE` while another application owns the root window, `screen_packages()` makes TC-08b pass incorrectly.
Suggested fix
```diff --- "a/e2e_test/conftest.py" +++ "b/e2e_test/conftest.py" @@ -112,9 +112,14 @@ return [html.unescape(v) for v in values] def screen_packages() -> set[str]: - """Packages owning nodes in the current UI, independent of LLM summaries.""" - return set(re.findall(r'package="([^"]+)"', _screen_xml())) + """Package owning the active UI window, independent of LLM summaries.""" + xml = _screen_xml() + match = re.search( + r']*>\s*]*\bpackage="([^"]+)"', + xml, + ) + return {match.group(1)} if match else set() def _stop_app() -> None: ```

> **IMPORTANT** > Review the replacement and indentation, then test before committing. ```suggestion def screen_packages() -> set[str]: """Package owning the active UI window, independent of LLM summaries.""" xml = _screen_xml() match = re.search( r']*>\s*]*\bpackage="([^"]+)"', xml, ) return {match.group(1)} if match else set() ```

**Reject negated heading statements in the saved-PDF check.** `PDF_HEADING` matches `heading LONGVITA` even when the sentence negates it. A final summary such as `No heading LONGVITA is visible in the blank preview.` passes this check. If the system print preview is open, the viewer-package check also passes, so TC-08b can pass without a visible printed heading. Add a negation guard to the assertion. Then add the negated sentence to the negative fixtures so the regression test covers it.
